current_flow: FrameState carries typed ViewId, FrameId, SurfaceGeneration, MetricsGeneration, and immutable SurfaceMetrics. FramePlan reaches the renderer-neutral IRenderBackend, and the private Headless Skia backend can produce deterministic raster evidence. Render Core has no live-surface snapshot or presentation feedback tracker.
target_owner: Render Core owns renderer-neutral live-surface generation validation and frame-to-feedback correlation. Future platform hosts own native targets and transport proof facts; G3-06 owns no native resource, platform callback, scheduler, or CanonicalVisible policy.
target_flow: A SurfaceLifecycle exposes one immutable current per-view snapshot. A matching FrameState is recorded as PresentSubmitted. Exact PlatformQualified Presented feedback may transition only that known record to Presented while its surface and metrics generations remain live.
prepare_commit_publication_abort: Replacement/submission/feedback input is validated against typed identities and current live state before one value-state replacement. Metrics-only, surface-only, and combined generation advances are independent and non-regressing. Every invalid, stale, unknown, or duplicate case returns a typed disposition without partial mutation.

obligation_to_verification.G3-06-V1-surface-generation-lifecycle: exact acquire plus metrics-only, surface-only, combined, both-equal/either-regressing/zero/wrong-view/invalid/lost field-level oracles
obligation_to_verification.G3-06-V2-submitted-versus-presented: submission-only intermediate state followed by exact qualifying feedback transition
obligation_to_verification.G3-06-V3-stale-feedback-rejection: generation A submit, generation B or loss, rejected A feedback with unchanged state, successful B presentation
obligation_to_verification.G3-06-V5-boundary-and-regression: authorized path and public-header scans, G3 matrix, locked-SDK Headless, RF01/G2, and diff check
